questions.question: Dr. Ahmed, now a national reference for seniors, is invited to an international congress. What message should he convey?
options: Seniors are the living memory of the profession
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Seniors are the living memory of the profession.' Sofia: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create a foundation to promote senior mentoring. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Promoting transmission and mentoring is essential for the future of the profession.' Ahmed: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must write a reference work on professional aging. What is the central message?
options: Aging is an art that combines experience and wisdom
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Aging is an art that combines experience and wisdom.' Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should she leave?
options: Professional aging is a wealth for the profession
Professional aging is of no interest
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Professional aging is a wealth for the profession.' Ahmed: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must create a senior mentoring program. What is the main objective?
options: Transmit experience and wisdom to the young
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Mentoring transmits experience and wisdom to the young.' Sofia: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must manage the succession of senior mentoring. What is the best strategy?
options: Progressively prepare the succession of mentors
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Progressive preparation for the succession of mentors is the key to a successful transmission.' Ahmed: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must create a seniors charter for dental practices. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Transmission and professional memory are the pillars of any seniors charter.' Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must train future senior mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission.' Ahmed: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must prepare a testimony on his senior journey. What is the most striking element?
options: The satisfaction of transmitting and accompanying
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'The satisfaction of transmitting and accompanying is the most striking element.' Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create an association of former seniors. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the bond and promote mutual aid
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Mutual aid and the bond are the driving forces of an association of former seniors.' Ahmed: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must write an article on the future of seniors. Which trend should be emphasized?
options: The importance of memory and transmission
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'The importance of memory and transmission is a promising trend.' Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create a senior quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Quality of transmission and mentoring are the fundamental criteria.' Ahmed: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should he leave?
options: The profession needs enthusiasts of mentoring
The profession is of no interest
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'The profession needs enthusiasts of mentoring.' Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create an award for senior mentors. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Excellence in mentoring is the driving force of the profession's evolution.' Ahmed: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must write his memoirs. What common thread should be highlighted?
options: The passion for transmission and service to the young
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'The passion for transmission is the common thread of a professional life.' Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create a training center for seniors. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Training must train mentors and transmitters.' Ahmed: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Skills passed on and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Skills passed on and an example to follow are the most beautiful legacy.' Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must write a letter to future dentists about seniors. What message should she convey?
options: Seniors are a wealth and a source of inspiration
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Seniors are a wealth and a source of inspiration.' Ahmed: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must create a scholarship for seniors in training. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Supporting deserving seniors is an investment for the future of transmission.' Sofia: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must give a closing speech. What note should she leave?
options: Seniors continue to inspire with their wisdom
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Seniors continue to inspire with their wisdom.' Ahmed: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must pass on his senior knowledge. What is the priority?
options: Sell his knowledge at the highest price
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Transmitting the continuity of skills is the most beautiful achievement.' Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create a peer network for senior mentors. What is the objective?
options: Promote mutual aid and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Mutual aid and sharing are essential for senior mentors.' Ahmed: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must write a conclusion to his work. What is the final sentence?
options: Professional aging is a magnificent human adventure
Professional aging is of no interest
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Professional aging is a magnificent human adventure.' Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must leave a message for future generations. What is the message?
options: Aging is a stage that deserves to be lived fully
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Aging is a stage that deserves to be lived fully.' Ahmed: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed, after a life dedicated to dentistry, receives a national tribute. Dr. Sofia is by his side. What is Ahmed's message to young dentists?
questions.explanation: Ahmed concludes: 'Dentistry needs passion and transmission to continue evolving.' Sofia: 'I am proud of you.'
